excerpt.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
excerpt.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

texts.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
texts.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

texts.zh:
在例行土地探察时意外地发现了[This.GetName]上大片土地的土壤质量近年来急剧提高。

我们相信许多此前认为不适合耕种的土地现在可以用来扩张农业活动了。
texts.en:
A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on [This.GetName] has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.

We believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.
